requestKind.description: Availability scope; omitted means text. Raw constraints retain every scope.

model.description: Optional model id/alias the caller intends to spend against. When present, each snapshot's availability.state is computed against this model (case-insensitive alias containment in either direction), so windows scoped to OTHER models never report the subject exhausted.

includeApiKeys.description: With a resources view, add API-key rows: registered API-key accounts and each harness's default API-key route (target.profile_id null).

ControlQuotaReadRequest.description: GET /v2/quota query selectors, each at most once; there is no body. Omitted requestKind means text availability, omitted model keeps the model-agnostic projection, and omitted view keeps the legacy shape. Reads cached snapshots without refreshing quota.
